raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.5.2"

package:
  name: rasterio
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rasterio/rasterio/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a3342f6a5102d8bb07d831b2390e217a2fd84afc49efbfe3e7cf36801de99c63

build:
  number: 2
  skip: match(python, "<3.12")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - rio = rasterio.rio.main:main_group

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.1,<=3.3
        - numpy >=2,<3
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - libgdal-core
    - proj
    - setuptools >=77.0.3
    - cython >=3.1,<=3.3
    - numpy >=2,<3
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - libgdal-core
    - cligj >=0.5
    - snuggs >=1.4.1
    - click-plugins
    - proj
    - affine
    - attrs
    - certifi
    - click >=4.0,!=8.2.*
    - numpy >=2
    - pyparsing >=3.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - rasterio
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      recipe:
        - test_data
    script:
      - rio --help
      - rio info test_data/test.tif
  - files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytest-cov >=2.2.0
        - aiohttp
        - boto3 >=1.2.4
        - fsspec >=2025.9.0
        - s3fs >=2025.9.0
        - hypothesis
        - libgdal-netcdf
        - matplotlib-base
        - packaging
        - requests
        - shapely
        - ca-certificates
        - pytest-randomly ==3.10.1
    script:
      - python -m pytest -v -m "not wheel" -rxXs tests/

about:
  summary: Fast and direct raster I/O for use with NumPy
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/rasterio/
  documentation: https://rasterio.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - weiji14
    - ocefpaf
    - ceholden
    - snowman2
    - akrherz
